goal: Heavy hangar scene performance (user report: 24 FPS, one logical CPU saturated)

diagnosis.tool: In-process stack sampler (F8 / WII_COMPILED_STACK_PROFILE_AT / _BELOW_FPS), dbghelp StackWalk64 with ReadProcessMemory reads; recomp/tools/summarize_stack_profile.py
diagnosis.frame_sync: fn_803E9F78 (CGraphics BeginScene) waits for the CP breakpoint callback fn_803E9820: one frame in flight

changes: Optional dedicated GX consumer thread (WII_COMPILED_PRIME_GPU_THREAD=1): committed gather bursts are queued; HLE FIFO decode, display lists and Aurora submission run on it. Host GX lock for VI/overlay/events; Sync for PI FIFO reset and uncaptured writes. Consumer never runs guest code or pumps SDL events.

CP breakpoint stall decided at burst submission; breakpoint status/interrupt raised only once the consumer is idle at it (async mode only). Draws spanning bursts are finished before a host section takes the GX lock.
Aurora: mutex-free sealed-frame encode outside interpolation (WII_COMPILED_AURORA_OVERLAP_ENCODE=1).
Aurora: GXEnd keeps the draw queued until the next drain (WII_COMPILED_AURORA_LAZY_END_DRAIN=1); raw texture/palette binds drain first.

Palette snapshot cache: content digest instead of TMEM load counter in the key, hash computed after the full key, 4096 entries/32 MiB, indexed replacement scan. Non-palette snapshot cache 2048 entries/64 MiB.
Vertex-state republish memo keyed by HLE inputs plus Aurora GXAuroraVtxStateEpoch().
DSP mailbox poll lock-free peek; IPC/DSP poll skips context scope when nothing is pending.
DVD: bulk copy into guest RAM when no executable guard applies; ISO SHA-1 group validation off by default (WII_COMPILED_PRIME_VALIDATE_ISO_HASHES=1 restores it).
Launchers run_prime_keyboard_mouse.ps1 / run_parallel_candidate.ps1 enable the three renderer modes; -SyncRenderer disables them.

measurements_unattended_same_build.method: recomp/tools/bench_prime_unattended.ps1, boot without input to the hangar, Aurora 5 s present windows; timeline varies between runs
measurements_unattended_same_build.palette_cache_after: 204031 lookups, 41 misses per 5 s (before: 60% misses, ~200 key probes per lookup)
measurements_unattended_same_build.user_live_confirmation: user observed 52-58 FPS and correct 3D in this mode

validation.partial_draw_warnings: 0 after draw-atomic GX lock (were 16-690 per run before that fix)
validation.frame_change_check: consecutive window captures differ over 75 s
validation.profiler_crash: RtlVirtualUnwind faulted on a suspended thread's stack once; replaced by StackWalk64 with safe reads, later captures survived

staging_capacity_fix.cause: User F8 profile at ~40 FPS: Aurora vertex staging (3 MiB) filled every frame; split_staging_batch encoded, submitted and remapped mid-frame on the GX consumer thread.
staging_capacity_fix.change: aurora gfx/common.hpp: vertex 16 MiB, index 8 MiB, storage 32 MiB staging (uniform unchanged).
staging_capacity_fix.result: Unattended hangar run 60.0 FPS in the heavy section; consumer idle ~6 s per 10 s. User confirmed 60 FPS with the F9 overlay hidden. Platform tests 21/21 PASS.

video_regression_fix.symptom: Boot THP videos corrupted and title/menu background video frozen since ChatGPT commit ad3fcba (generation-skip for raw texture snapshots).
video_regression_fix.cause: THP frames reach MEM2 through locked-cache store DMA (mtspr 923, ppc_helpers.cpp), which did not bump GxGuestWrite generations; the cache trusted an unchanged generation and reused the previous frame. Translated dcbf/dcbst/dcbi are no-ops and the DC/LC HLE overrides sit at Mario Kart addresses, so Prime DCFlushRange (0x804DF8F4) and neighbours do not notify either.
video_regression_fix.fix: LC store DMA now calls GxNotifyGuestRamDmaWrite for the RAM range.
video_regression_fix.validation: Unattended boot captures change frame to frame through the intro and menu video; user confirmed videos play.
video_regression_fix.remaining_risk: Textures written by the CPU without DMA still rely on generations that DCFlushRange does not advance; hooking 0x804DF8C8/0x804DF8F4/0x804DF924/0x804DF954/0x804DF980 through prepare_prime_runtime_hooks.py would close it.

limits: Unattended idle-camera scene only; manual QA of longer gameplay, map, radio, cutscenes pending.
Bitdefender user-mode hooks remain ~9% of the guest thread in the earlier profile; an exclusion is a user decision.
Overlay render-stage timers are per thread and mostly describe the consumer only when it records them.
ISO, DOL and matching tree untouched.
